items:
Isolate the circuit breaker of the 
pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of the 
pump motor

Isolate the pump mechanically by 
closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be completely 
drainage.

Check discharge quantity and pump 
 pressure then, compare it with the setting value and replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).

Measure vibrations level for 
 bearings and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine 
 what to do (if it is needed).

Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting value.

Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed).

Make test for bearings oil and add 
 or change it (if it is needed).

Check glands for water leakage and 
 re-pack (if it is needed).

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed).

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed every 
six months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Gamal Mostafa, tested at 30 May 2003, revised by EDEPCo. quality control 
eng. Abouda Elbana, accepted by eng Ali Mostafa El lithy, and 
approved by eng. Mostafa Alaam Talkha PS Head Sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, ....etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the 
pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of the 
pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely 
drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.Manual 
puller.

gauge, 
 Dial

Work to be carried out
Pump in Service
Check discharge quantity and pump 
 pressure then, compare it with the setting value and replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).
Measure vibrations level for 
 bearings and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine 
 what to do (if it is needed).
Pump out of Service
Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting value.
Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Make test for bearings oil and add 
 or change it (if it is needed).
Check glands for water leakage and 
 re-pack (if it is needed).
Check flanges for water leakage.
Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed).
